messages:
maya: Heads-up: inbound launch post + benchmark blurbs are ready. Need final changelog lines, canonical docs URL, and canary timing so we can lock embargo.
leo: Paste the exact changelog you plan to publish and the canary windows. Also confirm whether to call out Dedicated vs Hosted behavior.
maya: Changelog snippet (proposed): "Improved routing with new canary rollout; automatic lightweight-fallback preserves latency under load. See docs for full details." Draft docs (staging): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/releases/apr-2026-draft
sam: For public copy, short Dedicated note is good: "Dedicated customers keep pinned capacity by default; Hosted customers get automated fallback unless opted out."
harper: Webinar planned Tue 04/07 16:00 PT. Registration needs UTMs: utm_campaign=apr_release_2026&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email. SFDC queue: inbound-ml > product. Paid ads add utm_term=paid and set lead_priority=high.
sre-bot: Canary job queued: name=apr-2026-canary, variant=quant-lite-v1, initial=10%, monitor=/ops/releases/apr-2026
leo: Eng canary windows: start Tue 04/07 00:00 UTC at 10% (hold 6h) -> 50% Wed 04/08 08:00 UTC -> full Fri 04/10 02:00 UTC if green. Rollback target: stable-v1.
maya: Marketing needs go/no-go by EOD to set embargo lift window Thu 04/09 09:00 PT. React with :thumbsup: when your lane is green.
sam: :thumbsup: Docs ready to publish once you lock text.
harper: :thumbsup: I'll wire UTMs into the form and update SFDC mapping.
sre-bot: Will post alerts here if canary raises regression.
